'''Kader Tentrata''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in command of the [[GAT-12j]] [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray blastboat]] ''[[Greetbos]]''. He was assigned to patrol the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a sullen individual who envied the [[Captain/Legends|captain]]s of the sector's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] ''[[Rintonne's Flame]]''. His poor temperament often meant that [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] stopped by Tentrata frequently received harsher punishments than were warranted by their actions.<ref name="PoG3" />
